title: Ruleset: rare_items
description: rules/<id>/rare_items.yaml: the rare items (an engine improvement, the option rare_items, off by default): as a map loads, each of its spots has chance_percent in 100 of one item of the pool instead of the item its head script rolls there (packages/session: field_items_adapter.hpp).

chance_percent.description: The chance of a spot, in 100.

pool.description: The items that may lie, ids of data/items; one lies only while the bag holds none of it and none lies on the ground.

maps.description: The spots of each map, by map id.

spots.description: The cells [column, row] the map's head script lays its random items on (spawn_item).

unless_trigger.description: The story trigger after which the head lays no items any more.
